candidateFeedPolicy.name: mwis-primary-plus-zone-recovery
candidateFeedPolicy.primary: MWIS over roleLogit minus the trained segment penalty; primary spans are capped first by descending contribution with code-point tie breaks.
candidateFeedPolicy.recovery: The highest-logit span from each zone without a retained primary is ordered by raw role logit, then longer span, lower UTF-16 start, and normalized-name code points. Non-overlapping spans fill only the capacity left by primaries.
candidateFeedPolicy.implicitPrimaryFloor: MWIS excludes a span when roleLogit minus segmentPenalty is negative; with zero penalty this is a roleLogit floor of zero.
